title: Bolto
extract:
The Bolto is a Tenno secondary that fires piercing bolts with a noticeable travel time.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000, it is also a weapon crafting ingredient for  Akbolto (x2) and  Hystrix.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Can use the Bolto-exclusive  Entropy Spike mod.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Above average accuracy (0.50° to 7.00°)
Above average reload speed (1.30 s)
High ammo max (210)
Very high disposition (●●●●● (1.51x))
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average crit chance (16.00%)
Below average burst DPS (260.85)
Below average sustained DPS (202.43)
Low fire rate (3.33 attacks/sec)
Very low status chance (2.20%)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Bolto (Normal Attack), compared to  Akbolto (Normal Attack):
Equal base damage
Lower burst DPS (260.85 vs. 352.51)
Lower sustained DPS (202.43 vs. 253.60)
Lower fire rate (3.33 attacks/sec vs. 4.50 attacks/sec)
Smaller magazine (15 vs. 30)
Faster reload time (1.30 s vs. 2.60 s)
Lower Mastery Rank required (7 vs. 8)
Higher disposition (●●●●● (1.51x) vs. ●●●●○ (1.30x))

Acquisition
The Bolto's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Notes
Bolts pin killed enemies to walls or floors.
Bolto can puncture a container and has a 100% chance to destroy the container behind it. The  Akbolto does not have this capability.
Upon release, the Bolto created no noise when fired, making it SILENT, but in its upgrade section of the Arsenal its noise level was listed as ALARMING. This was because enemies may still be alerted if the player hits the ground around the target. This was a bug and is no longer the case as of Hotfix: Specters of the Rail 2.2 (2016-08-10), Bolto (along with Akbolto and Telos Akbolto) are now ALARMING at all times.
Unlike its akimbo variant, the Bolto doesn't have a prime version.

Tips
Higher fire rate can be achieved by tapping the trigger at specific intervals, not quickly tapping the trigger, as the fire rate will be lower.
Pacing shots allows the Bolto to recover from a shot's muzzle climb, improving the accuracy of the following shot.
The innate  polarity can somewhat limit elemental modding potential, thus making it a less desirable polarity for elemental modding. If you wish to focus more on elemental damage, then it is recommended to either ignore the polarity or use Forma to turn it into a more suitable polarity.
